# Pulsarium

> Pulsarium is an independent stock and ETF portfolio tracker and financial news platform for individual investors. It provides a free stock market news dashboard at pulsarium.finance and a free personal account at app.pulsarium.finance for tracking portfolios, dividends, watchlists and price alerts. Users record transactions manually or import broker export files; their investments remain with their chosen broker. Paid tiers with an AI research assistant are planned.

## Personal cabinet (app.pulsarium.finance, free beta)
- Portfolio tracking: several portfolios in different currencies, positions, weights, performance over time, per-position weight limits.
- Dividends and stock splits: detected automatically and applied after the investor confirms them; dividend history per holding.
- Broker file import: transaction exports from Revolut, DEGIRO, Trading 212, Interactive Brokers (IBKR activity statements), Robinhood, Fidelity, Charles Schwab, E*TRADE, Webull, Saxo, XTB and Zerodha, plus CSV or TSV files from other brokers with column mapping (remembered per file format). No broker login or credentials are needed — only the exported file.
- Watchlists with price alerts above or below a level, with email notifications.
- Signal Feed: news filtered to the investor's holdings and watchlists.
- Company pages: one page per stock with price history, the investor's position, price alerts, private notes and news; for US-listed companies, key figures from SEC filings (revenue, margins, P/E, balance sheet, cash flow) and dividend per share by year.
- Privacy and security: two-factor authentication (TOTP), Google sign-in, row-level data isolation, full data export and self-service account deletion.
- Market data may be delayed.

## News (pulsarium.finance)
- [Live news dashboard](https://pulsarium.finance/news/): stock market headlines aggregated from public sources (Yahoo Finance, CNBC, MarketWatch, Nasdaq, Investing.com, CoinDesk and sector outlets), tagged by ticker and sector and scored for sentiment and importance. Refreshes throughout the trading day.
- [News by company and sector](https://pulsarium.finance/news/companies/): one page per company (e.g. [Nvidia](https://pulsarium.finance/news/nvda/)) and per sector with the last 30 days of headlines and a sentiment summary.
- [Daily digest](https://pulsarium.finance/news/daily/): each day's top stories, sentiment and most mentioned companies.
- [RSS feed](https://pulsarium.finance/news/feed.xml) of the latest headlines.
- [Pulsarium Mood Index](https://pulsarium.finance/mood/): a daily 0-100 score of how positive the day's stock market headlines are (50 = neutral), with history as [JSON](https://pulsarium.finance/mood/history.json) and sector moods.

## Guides and tools
- Cabinet features: [portfolio tracker](https://pulsarium.finance/portfolio-tracker/), [dividend tracker](https://pulsarium.finance/dividend-tracker/), [price alerts](https://pulsarium.finance/price-alerts/), [why Pulsarium](https://pulsarium.finance/why-pulsarium/).
- [Broker import guides](https://pulsarium.finance/import/): step by step for Revolut, DEGIRO, Trading 212, Interactive Brokers, Robinhood, Fidelity, Charles Schwab, E*TRADE, Webull, Saxo, XTB and Zerodha.
- [Free calculators](https://pulsarium.finance/tools/): dividend yield, DCA (monthly investing) and portfolio rebalancing.
